notes.title: GO-KART RACING 2 LAUNCH
notes.content:
Today,  I have an exciting announcement to make in regards to the Go-Kart Racing series that was launched six years here on Steam.

Go-Kart Racing 2 is set to launch TONIGHT at midnight.   The second installment will feature many exciting changes that were highly requested by loyal players over the years.  These features include a brand new career mode that allows you to race for a championship over the course of a season.  Compete to earn points and keep track of your statistics,  while also selling merchandise and managing your team finances.

In addition to the new career season mode.   We also have Online Trials,  an all-new mode that allows you to compete online against your rivals on the Steam Leaderboards.  Set record lap times and keep track of the world records to ensure that you're near the top of the leaderboards.

For those that prefer a simpler and quicker racing experience,  you can also return to Quick Races and select your desired race length and difficulty.  

You are also able to customize your driver information,  paint livery colors,  and more! 

As mentioned above,  Go-Kart Racing 2 launches at midnight on January 29th.   

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3455030/GoKart_Racing_2/?curator_clanid=45275876

notes.title: GO-KART RACING - MAJOR UPDATE - JANUARY 2025
notes.content:
[h2][b]MAJOR UPDATE (JANUARY 2025)[/b][/h2]
Hello Go-Kart Drivers!

After more than seven years of the release of Go-Kart Racing on Steam,  I am proud to announce a MAJOR update for the game that will be available immediately! There's a long list of updates,  so feel free to take a look below.

[b]Update Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] HDRP Added to Rendering and Major Graphics Overhaul

[*] Three Reimagined HDRP Race Tracks Replace the Original Lower-Quality Tracks

[*] Major AI Driving Overhauls Increase AI Knowledge and Competitiveness

[*] Aerodynamic Drafting System with Slipstream Effects

[*] Reimagined Karting Physics and Updated Racing Physics

[*] Completely New UI Interface for Cleaner Presentation

[*] Results Screen with More Data

[*] Added Difficulty Settings for AI Drivers

[*] Animated Steering Wheel with New Onboard Camera 
 
[*] And MUCH More! 
[/list]
